name: Mamiya Takuji
source:
The protagonist of the final view.

The boy who stands at the heart and center of the End Sky World.

Beyond the world he leads, that sky exists.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.keroq.co.jp/suba_10th/tuinosora_remake/index.html]official website[/url].]
